items.subject: Security alert
items.summary: Google reported a new passkey added to the account, followed by a new account sign-in alert.
items.action: Confirm whether you added the passkey and made the sign-in. If either is unfamiliar, open Google Account Security directly, review activity, remove the passkey, secure the account and sign out unfamiliar sessions.
items.decisionNeeded: Confirm whether the new passkey and sign-in were yours.
